data.title: 矢来美羽 · 停在七点十二分的钟
data.description: 昨晚停电，客厅的摆钟还停在七点十二分。美羽回家换上浅绿色居家服，在靠窗的桌边坐下。她一手托着钟底，一手转动调时柄，看分针赶上窗外的暮色。
data.action: 托住摆钟，转动钟背的调时柄
data.camera: 中景，桌面略低于画面中心
data.promptProse: Miu sits at her living-room table in a pale green short-sleeved top and matching cropped trousers. One palm supports the wooden clock while her other hand turns the setting knob at the back. Late window light reaches the dial and her downturned face.
data.animaCaption: She steadies the clock on one palm while turning the setting knob with her other hand.
